column1: # AIR-021 verdict mutants. Columns, tab separated: id, patch file (in scripts/canary), harness name substring that must fail on it.
# `-` means the patch must survive Kani (unit tests and the differential catch it). A comma lists several substrings that must all fail.
# C1, C3 and C4 are the canary names AIR-031 expects; scripts/mutants.sh runs every row.
